project.title: Student Voices at Parliament House
project.description: A one-day visit to Parliament House in Darwin. Students will learn how laws are made, then meet our local member of parliament to hand over a petition asking for longer work-hour limits on student visas.
project.who_can_attend: Open to all international students studying in the Northern Territory. Entry is free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Social connection and wellbeing for international students.
